column3: a. 好笑的, 滑稽的, 逗趣的
column5: The ambassador told a droll story about a mismatched state banquet.
column6: 大使讲了一个国宴安排错位的滑稽故事。

column3: a. 欢乐的；喧闹的
column5: The pub erupted into rollicking song after the local team's surprise victory.
column6: 本地球队爆冷获胜后，酒馆里爆发出欢闹的歌声。

column3: n. 没收物, 罚金, 丧失;没收, 没收物, 罚金
column5: Repeated doping violations now carry an automatic forfeiture of titles and medals.
column6: 屡次违禁用药如今将自动剥夺头衔和奖牌。

column3: n. 拥挤, 行不通, 为许多圆木材所阻
column5: A single disputed clause created a legislative logjam that lasted months.
column6: 一个有争议的条款造成持续数月的立法僵局。

column3: n. 恶棍, 骗徒, (纸牌的)杰克;流氓行为, 无赖, 恶棍
column5: The comedy's knave tricks a greedy merchant out of his cargo.
column6: 喜剧里的无赖骗走了贪心商人的货物。

column3: n. (可开闭的)吊桥
column5: The castle's drawbridge still rises each evening for the sound-and-light show.
column6: 城堡的吊桥每晚仍在声光秀中升起。

column3: a. 吃力的, 缓慢的, 不自然的, 矫揉造作的
column5: The patient's labored breathing worried the nurses more than the fever.
column6: 病人吃力的呼吸比发烧更让护士担心。

column3: a. 推论的, 演绎的;推定的, 推断的, 演绎的
column5: The course pairs deductive logic exercises with messy real-world case files.
column6: 这门课把演绎逻辑练习与繁杂的真实案例结合。

column3: n. 烤架, 格状物
column5: The old stadium's gridiron now hosts lacrosse as football moves downtown.
column6: 老体育场的橄榄球场如今举办长曲棍球赛。

column3: n. 偏心, 偏颇, 不公平, 特别喜欢, 癖好;偏袒, 偏见, 不公平
column5: The referee's evident partiality toward the home side angered the visiting coach.
column6: 裁判明显偏袒主队，激怒了客队教练。

column3: n. 小手鼓
column5: The folk trio added a tambourine to brighten the final chorus.
column6: 民谣三重奏加入小手鼓，让最后的副歌更明快。

column3: a. 酸的, 尖刻的
column5: His acerbic reviews could end a restaurant's season with a single column.
column6: 他尖刻的评论一篇就能终结一家餐厅的旺季。

column3: n. 美观而无价值的东西, 玩具, 小玩意
column5: The prince traded his kingdom for a shining but worthless bauble.
column6: 王子用王国换来一件光鲜却一文不值的小玩意。

column3: a. 预先考虑的, 预谋的;经预先计划的, 预谋的
column5: Prosecutors argued the attack was premeditated, planned weeks in advance.
column6: 检方辩称袭击是数周前就预谋好的。

column3: n. 长鬈发, 小圈, 小环
column5: The portrait shows the child with a loose ringlet across her forehead.
column6: 画像里的孩子额前垂着一绺散开的鬈发。

column3: a. 旋涡状的;vi. 旋转, 不停地转动
column5: Dancers gyrate behind the lead singer during the song's thunderous finale.
column6: 歌曲震撼的尾声中，舞者在主唱身后旋转起舞。

column3: n. 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞美
column5: The playwright shrugged off the plaudits and returned to her desk.
column6: 剧作家对赞誉不以为意，转身又回到书桌前。

column3: vi. 忧郁, 闲荡;vt. 使忧郁
column5: Teenagers often mope in their rooms after a friendship ends abruptly.
column6: 友谊突然结束后，青少年常闷在自己房间里郁郁寡欢。

column3: n. 金花鼠
column5: A curious chipmunk raided the picnic basket within two unsupervised minutes.
column6: 一只好奇的金花鼠趁人不备两分钟就洗劫了野餐篮。

column3: vt. 引渡, 获取(逃犯等)的引渡;引渡, 使被引渡
column5: The courts refused to extradite the fugitive until torture risks were addressed.
column6: 在酷刑风险得到处理前，法院拒绝引渡该逃犯。

column3: n. 技巧, 诡计, 熟练
column5: The card trick depends on sleight of hand rather than any special deck.
column6: 这个纸牌戏法靠的是手法而非特制纸牌。

column3: vi. 撤营, 逃走, 逃亡;撤退, 逃走, 逃亡
column5: The advertising firm decided to decamp to a cheaper city after the merger.
column6: 合并后，广告公司决定迁往成本更低的城市。

column3: n. 宏亮的, 响亮的, 作响的;响声的, 作响的
column5: The cathedral's sonorous bells mark every quarter hour for the town.
column6: 大教堂洪亮的钟声为小镇报出每刻钟。

column3: a. 钝的, 不锋利的, 愚钝的;钝形的, 迟钝的(智力)
column5: The villain's obtuse henchmen misunderstand even the simplest instruction.
column6: 反派愚钝的手下连最简单的指令都会理解错。

column3: a. 诙谐的
column5: The professor's jocular asides made dense statistics lectures easier to survive.
column6: 教授诙谐的插科打诨让艰深的统计课好熬多了。

column3: n. 武断, 教条主义
column5: Good science training tempers dogmatism with a habit of testing claims.
column6: 良好的科学训练用检验结论的习惯来削弱教条主义。

column3: vt. 填...以防漏
column5: Workers caulk the hull seams before the fishing fleet sails in May.
column6: 渔船队五月出海前，工人们把船体接缝填密。

column3: a. 张口发呆的, 目瞪口呆的;adv. 张口发呆地, 目瞪口呆地
column5: The children watched agape while the magician produced a live dove.
column6: 魔术师变出一只活鸽子时，孩子们看得目瞪口呆。

column3: n. 行列, 骑马行列, 一系列
column5: A cavalcade of vintage motorcycles roared through the mountain villages at noon.
column6: 正午时分，一队古董摩托车轰鸣着穿过山村。

column3: n. 用颤音唱的歌, 鸟啭, 颤声;v. 鸟鸣, 用柔和的颤声唱
column5: Blackbirds warble from the chimney pots long before the city wakes.
column6: 早在城市苏醒前，乌鸫就在烟囱管上鸣啭。
